text: Heterogeneous HRF slice now reaches the public model path: ModelBuildSpec.hrfByCell is forwarded into EventModelBuilder, and mixed-width ConvolvedTerm/DesignColmap lowering uses actual assigned basis widths with structural cell/basis provenance.
